class.name: EnetStarTransport
class.brief_description: Star transport for [TickNetwork] over ENet and [SceneMultiplayer].
class.description: Sends the messages of a [TickNetwork] with [method SceneMultiplayer.send_bytes], so the game keeps using RPCs and [member SceneMultiplayer.auth_callback] on the same connection. The sender of each packet is the peer identified by the connection, never a value in the packet. [method create_server] and [method create_client] create the ENet peer with the compression mode and, optionally, DTLS encryption. For a custom setup, configure a [SceneMultiplayer] and call [method setup]. For debugging, [member simulated_latency], [member simulated_jitter] and [member simulated_packet_loss] degrade the packets sent by this end. [codeblock] var transport := EnetStarTransport.create_server(7000, 32) $TickNetwork.start(transport) [/codeblock]

method.name: create_client
method.description: Creates an ENet client connecting to [param address]:[param port]. The [param compression] mode must be the same as the server's. With [param tls_options], the connection is encrypted with DTLS and the server certificate is validated against [param tls_hostname] (the address by default). Returns [code]null[/code] on failure.

method.name: create_server
method.description: Creates an ENet server listening on [param port] for up to [param max_clients] clients. With [param tls_options] (see [method TLSOptions.server]), the connections are encrypted with DTLS. Returns [code]null[/code] on failure.

method.name: get_multiplayer
method.description: Returns the [SceneMultiplayer] used by this transport. It can be set as the scene tree's multiplayer to use RPCs on the same connection; then disable [member poll_multiplayer].

method.name: setup
method.description: Uses a [SceneMultiplayer] configured by the game. Its peer must support at least 6 channels (the module uses channels 1 to 5). Set [param encrypted] when the connection uses DTLS, so the payload size accounts for it.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the transport polls its [SceneMultiplayer]. Disable it when the game already polls it (for example, when it's the scene tree's multiplayer).
Random extra delay, up to this value in seconds, added to each packet sent by this end. Reliable packets keep their order. For debugging only.
Delay, in seconds, added to each packet sent by this end. For debugging only.
Probability, from 0 to 1, of dropping an unreliable packet sent by this end. For debugging only.

constants.constant: ENet's range coder, suited for small packets. The default.
Zstandard compression; not efficient on packets smaller than 4 KB.
